lines.text: Wait! Small vs Tall Fall: Why Cats ALWAYS Land on Their Feet!
Most kids guess totally wrong about how cats always land on their feet!
Stop and picture what actually happens inside.
Cats use a flexible spine, missing rigid collarbones, and inner-ear balance.
to twist their front paws first and back paws second mid-air.
Nature uses amazing science tricks right under our noses!
Even many grown-ups still believe the old rumor instead of this fact!
Now you know the real truth behind Cat Flip Secret!
